records.title: AI Researcher Intern
records.officialDescription:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About the role

HackerRank is advancing AI-driven Technical Interviewing, assessment of Integrity, and the measurement of Engineering skill to use AI assistance effectively in the agentic era. We are looking for research-oriented M.S./Ph.D. scholars to explore and develop novel Deep Learning architectures and build efficient, trustworthy AI systems. A key research direction is to develop a model-agnostic external Recursive Reasoning Engine that enables smaller models (SLM/SSM/Hybrid etc.) to solve complex, repository-grounded software engineering tasks with greater effectiveness, traceability, and lower inference cost.

Open problems

The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you’ll be working across, none of them fully solved.

• Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.

• Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.

• Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.

Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.

What you will do

• Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.

• Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.

• Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.

• Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation

• Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.

• Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses.

• Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems.

Who you are

• M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D. in AI/ML or related disciplines.

• 2-3 years of experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, or Applied AI Research.

• Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms.

• Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience.

• Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch.

• Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation.

• Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc.

Even better if you have

• Understanding of Evaluation Benchmarks for S/W Engineering Tasks and Human-Agent Collaborations

• Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure.

You will thrive here if you

• You enjoy solving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions.

records.title: Finance and Strategy Data Analyst
records.officialDescription:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

We are building an elite team to drive financial insight and strategy at Stripe. The Corporate Finance & Strategy team brings understanding and predictability to Stripe’s financials, and we work together with our key business partners to accelerate long term growth for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

• Partner with F&S and the Business to drive the long-term success of Stripe

• Ensure month close processes get done efficiently, accurately, and on time

• Partner across Finance, eg. Strategic Sourcing 

• Work cross functionally to identify important strategy questions and answer them with data

• Build financial forecasts and targets, track performance, and understand deviations from actuals to drive strategy and operational rigor

• Gain deep knowledge and understanding of Stripe's business performance across geographies and user segments

• Automating away recurring work by utilizing AI

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Experience in month end close processes and have demonstrated experience working closely and successfully across the other functions of the Finance Org (eg., Accounting, Tax, Treasury)

• Experience running recurring processes and organizing cross-functional partners and stakeholders to deliver materials on time (e.g. enabling, tracking, monitoring status, problem solving the month end close process; driving successful continuous improvement initiatives as it relates to domain of expertise)

• A strong understanding of accounting, accruals, and opex management

• Experience with financial analysis, financial forecasting, BvA (variance analysis), and other financial concepts

• Experience working on ambiguous problems and driving solutions/projects independently

• Ability to automate and use AI to streamline recurring tasks/analyses, in order to free up time to work on more strategic and higher impact work

• Experience building dashboards and data visualization tools from scratch

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners and department leads. You are seen as a trusted and objective advisor

• An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality

• A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision

• Experience working in a global capacity (this team will work will all regions)

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in a strategic finance function at a high-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space

records.officialDescription:
Technical Account Engineer - I 

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

About the Role

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

What You Will Actually Do

• Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.

• Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.

• Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.

• See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.

• Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.

• Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.

• Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

Where and When

• This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.

• Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.

• You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

What You Will Bring

• 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.

• Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.

• A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.

• Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.

• A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

Role Overview

The Quality Control Intern - Hardware is the checkpoint every recording rig passes through, in both directions. When rigs return from the field, you inspect their condition, run a functional check, and capture a short test recording that you review to confirm the cameras, footage, audio, and storage are all working. Before any rig goes back out, you give the final sign-off that it is field-ready.

This is a small role with an outsized impact: a rig that leaves your desk in a bad state means a Field Officer travels to a business, records for hours, and returns with unusable or missing data - a full day lost, and sometimes a burned business relationship. Your job is to make sure that never happens. Precision, consistency, and discipline are the whole game here.

What You'll Own

• Nothing goes to field without your approval; nothing comes back without your inspection and log.

Key Responsibilities

1. Inbound Inspection (rigs returning from cities)

• Receive rigs and accessories (cameras, SD cards, card readers, cables, mounts) as they return from the field

• Check physical condition - damage, loose mounts, worn cables, cleanliness - and log it

• Verify all issued components are present against the checkout record; flag anything missing

2. Functional QC & Test Recording

• Power up each rig and confirm cameras open, storage is available, and the device is charged/charging correctly

• Capture a short test recording and review it: cameras correctly aligned, footage clear and stable, audio present, timestamps correct

• Confirm the SD card reads correctly, the previous session's data has been offloaded, and the card is cleared and ready for reuse

• Only mark a rig "field-ready" once every check passes

3. Outbound Approval (clearing rigs for field)

• Give the final go/no-go before a rig is handed to a Field Officer

• Ensure the rig leaves fully charged, correctly configured, and with the right accessories

• Sign off in the tracker so every field-ready rig is traceable to your check

4. Fault Handling & Escalation

• Quarantine any rig that fails QC so it cannot accidentally go to field

• Log the exact fault clearly (which component, what's wrong) and escalate hardware faults to the Hardware/IT team

• Follow up so repaired rigs are re-checked before they re-enter circulation

• Maintain clean, complete QC records in Google Sheets - every rig, every check, pass/fail, date/time, and reason

• Keep the QC and quarantine areas organized and controlled

• Follow the QC checklist exactly, every single time - no shortcuts, no assumptions

Position Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically minded finance professional to join the Financial Planning & Analysis team at Squarepoint, a leading quantitative investment manager. The individual should have a solid understanding of financial data management and reconciliation, with experience working across finance systems and a confidence in ensuring data is accurate, well-structured, and fit for purpose. The role will focus on improving the quality and integrity of contract and financial data, as well as owning the tracking and loading of leasehold improvement spend, with outputs that directly improve the reliability of FP&A forecasting, reporting, and invoice processing across the business.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who takes pride in data accuracy, enjoys investigating and resolving financial misalignments, and is motivated by the opportunity to create tangible and lasting improvements in data quality and process. The role offers real visibility across the finance function and the chance to work with a broad range of stakeholders, making a meaningful impact on the quality of information that underpins decision-making across the business.

• Reviewing actual ledger postings against contract data to identify and resolve misalignments in financial attributions, ensuring contracts are correctly tagged at source across all relevant dimensions.

• Reviewing contract run rates against contracted values, engaging with business owners to understand and document variances and revise contract values where necessary.

• Reviewing inactive contracts to assess whether they should remain active, reducing noise in the data and improving forecast reliability.

• Collaborating with the Technology team to explore opportunities to improve recording of contract data in a way that enables more granular and accurate reporting.

• Working with external partners to ensure the monthly leasehold improvement trackers are completed accurately and capture all required information for FP&A and stakeholders.

• Loading leasehold improvement data into the FP&A forecasting platform on a monthly basis, ensuring it reconciles correctly and is available for stakeholder reporting and analysis.

Required qualifications:

• Relevant experience in a finance, FP&A, or financial control role, with a solid understanding of how financial data flows between systems and feeds into reporting and forecasting.

• Experience reconciling financial data across systems, with the ability to identify root causes of misalignments and work with stakeholders to resolve them.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships across all levels of the business.

• High personal standards, strong attention to detail and a desire to exceed expectations.

• An independent mindset, with the confidence to challenge existing processes and propose improvements.

• A well-structured, proactive work ethic with the ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• A curious mindset and a natural interest in understanding the wider business.

• Open to technology and motivated to find ways to streamline and improve processes.

• Familiarity with LLM tools in either a professional or personal context.

• Familiarity with a CRM or contract management system, and experience using a financial planning or EPM tool, would be advantageous.

• Experience with data visualisation, including graphs and dashboards, would be advantageous.

records.title: Research Engineering Intern, AI Evaluations
records.officialDescription:
Karya’s mission is to leverage the AI revolution to create dignified earning and learning opportunities for low-income communities across the world. In India, our smartphone-based digital work platform has enabled over 120,000 people to build language datasets and evaluate AI models while earning fair wages. With pilots in Kenya and Ethiopia and partnerships with leading AI labs, we are advancing language technologies for underrepresented communities. By combining dignified digital work with frontier AI innovation, Karya hopes to build a new AI economy that is equitable, inclusive, and community driven.

About the Role:

Karya's AI Evaluations team measures how well AI models serve people in the languages and contexts global benchmarks miss. We work with partners including Anthropic and Microsoft Research, alongside government and civil society, running evaluations on our own platform with native speakers and domain experts across India and beyond. Our benchmarks, leaderboards and reports aim to help model developers and decision-makers understand where models work well and where they fall short.

As a Research Engineering Intern, you will work alongside research engineers to build and run these evaluations, from setting up annotation tasks and running model inference to analysing results. You will own real parts of the pipeline end to end, including keeping them running when things break.

What You'll Do 

• Evaluation setup: prepare datasets, run model inference through APIs and self-hosted setups, and configure, batch and launch annotation tasks on the Karya platform.

• Pipeline operations: monitor live evaluations, triage and reproduce annotation app issues, coordinate fixes with platform and operations teams, and document recurring problems.

• Quality control: run automated checks on annotation data and flag anomalies before they affect results.

• Analysis and experiments: compute agreement, scores and breakdowns; support focused studies such as validating automated judges against human ratings; and contribute to technical reports and public releases.

• Infrastructure: build and maintain tested, documented tooling for data processing, QC and analysis, with logged configs for reproducibility.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP or a related field.

• Strong Python and comfort working with data (pandas or similar).

• Working knowledge of LLMs and modern ML, and familiarity with calling models via APIs.

• Solid foundation in probability and statistics.

• Methodical debugging skills, and willingness to dig into unfamiliar systems when something breaks.

Strong differentiators

• Experience with ML projects involving evaluation, annotation or human feedback data.

• Exposure to speech or multilingual NLP, especially Indian languages.

• Experience with GPU inference, cloud tooling or Android/app debugging.

Mindset

• Takes ownership of work end to end, knowing that reliable operations are what make evaluations trustworthy.

• Thrives in interdisciplinary teams spanning engineering, research, social science, operations and domain experts.

• Comfortable with ambiguity, messy data and shifting priorities.

• Cares about building AI that works for the people it is meant to serve.

Karya celebrates diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected status.

End User Support

• Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure AD, Intune, and endpoint management tools.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

• Team-player with willingness to learn and grow.

Work Environment

About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team at NK Securities. Data is at the core of everything we do, and this role will own how we source, store, validate, and understand it. You'll build reliable pipelines that bring data in from external sources, make sure it's clean and trustworthy, and dig into it to surface insights and issues before they become problems.

You'll work closely with our trading, research, and tech teams. This is a high-ownership role for someone who cares about getting the details right and wants to grow into a key part of our data infrastructure.

What You'll Do:

• Build and maintain pipelines to ingest data from multiple external sources, designed to be scalable and source-agnostic

• Design and implement data quality checks so that issues are caught early and automatically

• Handle data cleaning, missing values, and inconsistencies so downstream users can rely on the data

• Perform statistical analysis to identify anomalies, trends, and irregularities, and share clear reports with the team

• Maintain and manage databases, including backups, storage, and overall data health

• Develop a deep understanding of the datasets we use and serve as the go-to person for data-related questions

• Coordinate with internal teams and external providers to resolve data issues

What We're Looking For:

• Strong programming skills in Python

• Good understanding of SQL and working with databases

• Familiarity with working with APIs and handling different data formats

• Solid foundation in statistics and data analysis

• Strong attention to detail and a habit of questioning data that doesn't look right

• Ownership mindset: you take responsibility for data being correct and available on time

• Candidates with 1-3 years of experience are welcome

Good to Have:

• Experience with workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

• Exposure to financial or market data

• Familiarity with Linux and shell scripting

What we offer:

• Work in a fast-paced and exciting HFT environment

• Own critical data infrastructure that directly impacts trading and research

• Learn directly from experienced developers, researchers, and traders

• Competitive salary and a strong learning curve

• Catered breakfast and lunch.

• Monthly team dinners.

• Annual international and domestic team trips.

About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024. 

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together! 

The Role

We are looking for a technical support engineer to join our team in Gurgaon (hybrid) and help keep our production systems healthy through the night. This is a night-shift role, primarily graveyard hours (10:00 PM - 7:00 AM IST), rotating between two team members. You will be the first line of response for production alerts, incident triage and customer-facing technical issues outside regular business hours, making sure AiDASH products and platforms keep delivering for our customers around the clock. 

How you'll make an impact:

• Monitor application health and respond to alerts across production systems during your shift

• Own incident management - identify, triage and drive incidents to resolution, escalating to the right team when needed

• Investigate issues using logs and database queries to find the root cause

• Track tickets against SLA commitments and flag anything at risk of breach

records.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Agents
records.officialDescription:
About Prodigal

Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.

We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.

These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?

Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.

Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.

Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.

We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje

What You’ll Do

• Build and deploy LLM-powered AI agents (including voice agents) in production, designed for real-world use cases

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI systems - from problem scoping and design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration

• Design and optimize prompts, RAG pipelines, and evaluation frameworks to improve accuracy, latency, and reliability

• Work directly with customers and Implementation Managers (IMs) to understand workflows, solve real-world problems, and drive successful go-lives and iterations 

What We’re Looking For

• 1-3 years experience in backend / data / AI engineering

• Strong in Python + SQL

• Experience or exposure to LLMs, RAG, or prompt engineering

• High ownership, ability to work in ambiguity and ship fast

• Comfortable working with customers and cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualification

• B.Tech, BE, or M.Tech in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 1-3 years of relevant experience

Bonus

• Experience with production LLM systems / AI agents

• Familiarity with evaluation, agent tooling, or voice AI

• Experience with Databricks, MongoDB, or distributed systems

• Startup or customer-facing engineering experience

Why This Role

• Work on real production AI systems (not demos)

• End-to-end ownership and fast iteration cycles

• Direct impact on enterprise customers and business outcomes

Mode of Work - In-Office
From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.

RZR  is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.

Role Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. As an ML Engineer, you will be involved in designing and implementing machine learning models and data pipelines to enhance our programmatic demand-side platform (DSP). You will work closely with Senior MLE and other team members to drive impactful machine learning projects and contribute to innovative solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the development of machine learning models to address challenges in programmatic advertising, such as predicting user responses, forecasting bid landscapes, and detecting fraud.

Required Skills / Experience

records.title: Data Analyst - Advanced Analytics
records.officialDescription:
Company Overview 

ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London, Zurich and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world-class strategic decision-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives.

ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world-class strategic decision-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives. 

ClearView’s Data & Analytics practice is looking for motivated individuals to join our team as Data Analysts to accelerate the continued growth of our capabilities. Members of the data team work closely with the consulting staff and senior leadership to solve complex and unique problems in the life sciences. The data analysts will leverage common tools (i.e., SAS, SQL, R, and Python), large data sets, and creativity to build models and processes to support ClearView’s clients.

Responsibilities: 

As a Data Analyst, you will interact with internal and external teams to address critical strategic questions within the biopharmaceutical space. During the course of a typical project, you will: 

• Collect, clean, mine, and analyze data. 

• Serve as a knowledge resource for the consulting staff regarding statistics, machine learning, and life sciences data. 

• Design and create advanced models to drive analytically driven strategy projects. 

• Innovate project approaches and identify new life sciences problems to solve with analytics. 

• Aid in team building by making code scalable through templates, macros, or interfaces. 

• Clearly communicate analytical techniques and findings from analyses in a non-technical manner. 

• Work in a high-performance, strongly collegial, and collaborative environment. 

Requirements 

The successful candidate for the Data Analyst role must have the following skills and experience: 

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, Physics, or a related field. 

• Relevant experience of 1-3 years working on insurance claims and EHR databases - IQVIA (LAAD), Komodo (Sentinel), Forian, Compile and others.   

• Experience with large data manipulation in SAS or SQL interfaces. 

• Experience with life science APIs & public datasets (e.g., PubMed, OpenTrials, CMS, CDC, etc.). 

• Experience in at least one of the following areas: 

• Excel modeling (using a spreadsheet to make quantitative predictions based on a series of underlying assumptions). 

• Common machine learning models (e.g., neural networks, support vector machines, decision trees). 

• Advanced regression models (e.g., Bayesian, hierarchical, non-linear). 

• Unsupervised learning. 

• Advanced time series. 

• Detail-oriented with the ability to dive deep into business processes, data, and analytics. 

• Independent, creative, and driven quantitative thinker.

• Role is based out of our Gurgaon, India office.  

What We Value

We recognize that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration.

records.title: Product Security Engineer
records.officialDescription:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

What you will do

Development and remediation

• Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses, and add tests that prove the fix.

• Fix root causes, not single instances: build shared validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and authorization checks that remove whole classes of vulnerabilities.

• Upgrade vulnerable libraries, frameworks, and third-party components, resolve breaking changes, and keep builds and tests passing.

• Build internal security tooling and automation: scanner integrations, triage and reporting scripts, and checks that catch issues before release.

• Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines, and tune the rules to cut noise.

• Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.

• Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request and drive it to merge.

Security testing

• Test web applications and APIs for exploitable vulnerabilities.

• Review code and design for flaws in authentication, authorization, session handling, data flows, and secrets management.

• Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, or cloud accounts, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.

• Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.

Reporting and communication

• Write clear findings and fix notes with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and the change made.

• Agree on realistic remediation timelines with engineers, and share secure coding patterns so the same issues stop recurring.

What you bring

Experience

• 5+ years total: approx. 3.5 years building and shipping production software as a developer, and approx. 1.5+ years of hands-on security work such as VAPT, application security, or secure code review.

• A track record of fixing security issues in code.

Development expertise

• Production-level depth in at least two of: Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, or Kotlin. Comfortable reading and changing code in languages you know less well.

• Able to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase without breaking existing behavior.

• Web and API development: REST and GraphQL services; authentication with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT; session management; databases and ORMs.

• Unit and integration testing, Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.

• CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, and TLS configuration.

• Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.

Communication

At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.

Your impact

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Junior Electrical Engineer. The ideal candidate is a proactive "go-getter" who can effectively engage with clients, quickly understand their needs, and convert conversations into business outcomes.

What you'll do

We are seeking a motivated Junior Electrical Engineer to support the design, engineering, commissioning, and delivery of innovative liquid-cooled data centre solutions. The role provides exposure to global projects and mission-critical infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in preparing electrical layouts, SLDs, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts.

• Support load calculations, cable sizing, voltage drop, and protection coordination.

• Support electrical design for liquid-cooled data centre solutions.

• Coordinate with Mechanical, Controls, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Project Management teams.

• Participate in design reviews and technical meetings.

• Prepare BOMs, specifications, and engineering documentation.

• Support FAT, SAT, installation, testing, and commissioning.

• Troubleshoot electrical issues during commissioning.

• Prepare reports and maintain engineering documentation.

• Ensure compliance with IEC, NEC, IEEE, and company quality and HSE standards.

Required Qualifications

• E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or related stream

• 0- 6 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates with internships are encouraged.

• ETAP knowledge is mandatory

Technical Skills

• Knowledge of LV electrical distribution systems.

• Understanding of transformers, switchgear, UPS, PDUs, MCCBs/ACBs, earthing, and lightning protection.

• Ability to read electrical drawings.

• AutoCAD Electrical/AutoCAD proficiency.

• MS Office proficiency.

• Preferred: Revit MEP, ETAP/EPLAN, PLC/SCADA/BMS exposure, knowledge of TIA-942 and IEC standards.

Competencies

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

• Attention to detail.

• Good communication and teamwork.

• Ability to work in multicultural environments.

• Eagerness to learn.

Career Growth

    Exposure to data centre electrical design, liquid cooling technologies, critical infrastructure, commissioning, and global engineering projects.

What you'll need

Department: Engineering

Experience: 0-2 Years

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering

What we offer

• Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.

• A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.

• You´ll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands.

Our inclusive responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

• Document, track, and escalate identified defects clearly and in a timely manner. 

• Monitor production systems using established observability and monitoring tooling to proactively detect degradations in voice quality of service (QoS). 

• Support post-deployment validation testing, including off-hours deployments.

• Assist with special projects as assigned.

• Minimum 1-3 years of experience in software testing or QA, preferably in VoIP, SIP, or telecom-based applications.

• Foundational understanding of SIP (Session Initiation Protocol); including call flows, SIP methods (INVITE, BYE, REGISTER, OPTIONS), response codes, and SDP negotiation. 

• Hands-on experience testing phone and voice systems, including SIP soft clients, IP phones, or PSTN endpoints, using tools such as SIP, VoIPmonitor, Wireshark, or similar. 

• Familiarity with VoIP concepts: RTP/RTCP, codec negotiation (G.711, G.729, Opus), DTMF, MOS scoring, jitter, and packet loss.

• Ability to read and interpret SIP traces and packet captures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail, Jira, or equivalent. 

• Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and how they relate to hosted voice infrastructure. 

• Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) for automating basic test tasks or log parsing. 

• Understanding of emergency services (E911) or carrier-grade requirements is a plus.

• Build and maintain agentic pipelines and workflows under the guidance of senior engineers: tool use, orchestration, and multi-step reasoning.

• Implement and tune RAG pipelines - including embedding, chunking strategies, vector retrieval, and retrieval evaluation.

• Contribute to memory and context layer components: integrating vector databases, supporting knowledge graph pipelines, and helping maintain state management across agentic systems.

• Write clean, well-tested Python code and participate in code reviews.

• Debug and improve existing AI systems based on evaluation results and production feedback.

• Collaborate with data engineers and domain experts to integrate AI components with upstream data sources and downstream applications.

• Document implementations clearly and contribute to shared internal tooling.

• Working knowledge of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and at least one agentic or RAG framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent).

• Solid Python skills and comfort with software engineering basics: version control, testing, REST APIs.

• Curiosity about agentic AI - you follow developments in the space and are eager to apply new techniques.

• Stakeholder Mentality: Treats the company's and client’s goals as their own and is genuinely motivated by its success.

• Collaboration: A team player who builds strong working relationships and communicates effectively with colleagues across all levels.

Why You Will Love It Here: 

• Work on real-world AI and advanced analytics solutions with measurable business impact.

• Collaborate with a global team of engineers and data scientists.

• Exposure to diverse industries, modern cloud platforms, and cutting-edge AI technologies.

• A collaborative culture that values real outcomes.

• Rapid learning opportunities and diverse challenges.

records.title: Supplier Development Engineer (Starlink)
records.officialDescription:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (STARLINK)

SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.

As a Supplier Development Engineer focused on Final Assembly, Test, and Packout for Starlink, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of the user terminal manufacturing at our global suppliers.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Planning, proposing, and leading experiments to produce timely and accurate analyses used to drive design, development, and supply chain decisions, with a focus on scalability for high volume manufacturing

• Assessing the suitability of a fabrication technology for a given part design, including its potential for automation and cost-effective mass production

• Planning validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility as well as manufacturing capability at high volumes, incorporating throughput modeling and yield optimization

• Analyzing results of validation exercises and provide technical recommendations to enhance efficiency and reduce variability in large-scale production

• Reviewing progress of development activities at supplier locations and serve as point of escalation for critical process related issues, ensuring alignment with high volume ramp-up requirements

• Drive process development and capability assessment activities, reviewing part design documentation to ensure alignment with process capability for high volume manufacturing, including DFM principles for scalability and automation

A.P.T Portfolio is a high-frequency trading firm specialising in quantitative trading and investment strategies.

The Data Engineering team works on integrating, managing, and analysing data collected from the firm's trading activities and exchanges. The team also builds and maintains the firm's quantitative research, modelling, backtesting, and high-performance computing infrastructure.

You will be part of a curious, creative, and analytical team that enjoys building complex data infrastructure and working with data for research and analysis.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Engineer to develop, maintain, and support large-scale data processing and research pipelines.

The role is focused on on-premises infrastructure and Linux systems. Strong Linux administration and scripting skills are essential for this position.

You will work closely with developers, researchers, and other teams to ensure that data and research pipelines run smoothly and reliably.

Core Responsibilities

• 
Develop, maintain, and optimise data processing and research pipelines.

• 
Configure and manage open-source tools, software, and in-house applications.

• 
Explore new data infrastructure, storage, and automation tools, and build proof of concepts (POCs).

• 
Improve CI/CD pipelines and work towards building self-monitoring infrastructure.

• 
Set up backups and support data protection, disaster recovery, and failover processes.

• 
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues, identify root causes, and document solutions.

• 
Work with tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, Git, Nexus, and Argo CD.

• 
Automate routine tasks using Python, Bash, Ansible, and other scripting tools.

• 
Improve monitoring, alerting, and automation to reduce failures.

• 
Monitor and support daily data, analytics, and research pipeline operations.

• 
Coordinate with developers and product owners to resolve issues and minimise production downtime.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Computer Science or IT.

• 
1-5 years of relevant experience.

Strong Linux administration, scripting, and debugging skills - must have.

Strong Python and/or Bash scripting skills - must have.

Hands-on experience working with on-premises infrastructure.

Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, Agile, and continuous delivery concepts.

Strong automation and troubleshooting skills.

Linux | On-Prem Infrastructure | Python | Bash | Automation | DevOps | CI/CD | Ansible | Docker | Kubernetes

records.officialDescription:
At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics. 

Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.

We are looking for an SRE / Cloud Operations Engineer with 1-2 years of hands-on experience supporting cloud-based applications. The person will help maintain reliable, secure, and scalable platforms across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a strong focus on Kubernetes-based workloads.

The role involves monitoring services, troubleshooting production issues, supporting deployments, automating operational tasks, and collaborating with development and platform teams to improve availability and performance.

Team Size

The candidate will join the SRE team, partnering closely with application developers, security teams, and cloud infrastructure teams. The team owns platform availability, observability, incident response, deployment reliability, and operational automation.

Candidate Experience

• 1-2 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Operations, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Support.

• Hands-on experience working with Kubernetes, including deploying and troubleshooting pods, deployments, services, namespaces, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

• Exposure to supporting production applications and handling incidents or service requests.

• Experience working in at least one public cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Hands-on exposure to Linux administration, scripting, monitoring, containers, and Docker.

• Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and software deployment practices.

Skills (Non-negotiables & good to have)

• Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.

• Basic Kubernetes knowledge: pods, deployments, services, namespaces, ConfigMaps, Secrets, logs, and troubleshooting.

• Docker/container fundamentals.

• Linux troubleshooting and administration skills.

• Scripting knowledge in Bash or Python.

• Understanding of networking basics: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, load balancers, security groups/firewalls.

• Familiarity with monitoring and alerting concepts, such as metrics, logs, dashboards, and incident response.

• Good communication and problem-solving skills.

StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. records.title: Graduate Quantitative Developer
records.officialDescription:
DeepFin is a systematic proprietary trading firm combining deep learning, traditional quantitative research methods, and cutting-edge trading technology, to trade global markets. Founded by engineers and researchers, we build and deploy advanced trading systems that operate across global markets.

Our team is lean, highly technical, and impact-driven - every hire plays a direct role in shaping the firm’s technology, strategy, and performance. We value curiosity, precision, and collaboration, and we’re building an environment where exceptional people can do their best work at the intersection of AI and financial markets.

Junior Quant Developer - Backtesting, Simulation & Research, Productionise Research (C++/Python)

Role Overview

We’re hiring a junior Quant Developer to help productionise research into robust, high-performance trading systems. You’ll work closely with Quant Researchers and senior engineers to convert Python research code into production C++, build and optimise backtesting / simulation infrastructure, and support strategy development using L3 market data across multiple venues.

This is a hands-on, engineering-heavy role in a fast-moving environment: you’ll own components end-to-end and contribute directly to research velocity and trading PnL.

Key Responsibilities

• Productionise research models into C++: translate Python prototypes into efficient, maintainable C++ production code.

• Backtesting & simulation: build and improve simulation systems that reflect real market mechanics (order book, fills, cancels, exchange rules).

• L3 market data handling: ingest and process high-volume tick/order-level feeds; create reliable feature pipelines from raw exchange data.

• Performance optimisation: improve latency and throughput of backtests/sims (profiling, memory optimisation, data structures, parallelism where appropriate).

• Research support tooling: create utilities for data inspection, experiment tracking, run orchestration, and post-trade analytics in Python.

• Debugging & correctness: investigate mismatches between simulation and production behaviour; diagnose edge cases and implement fixes with strong test coverage.

• Cross-team collaboration: work daily with researchers and infra/exec engineers to ship improvements from idea → test → production.

Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s from a top university in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Physics, or similar.

• 0-3 years experience in quantitative finance or other relevant data-intensive industries working with C++

• Strong working knowledge of C++ (memory, ownership, STL, performance-aware coding).

• Experience: demonstrable evidence of hands-on systems work in C++ handling large-scale data (internships, research labs, competitive projects, open-source).

• Comfortable with Python for analysis, tooling, and debugging (pandas/numpy/Jupyter a plus).

• Exposure to quantitative finance, eg through internships/university societies, including market microstructure and L3/order book data.

• Clear “builder mindset”: you like owning problems end-to-end, shipping incrementally, and iterating quickly.

If you’re passionate about applying advanced technology to real-world markets and want to work alongside a focused, high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. DeepFin offers a collaborative, research-driven environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution and where every contribution has visible impact.

Join us in building the next generation of deep-learning-driven trading systems - shaping the future of finance through innovation, rigour, and technology.

records.officialDescription:
How do you want to pay? It’s a question you’ve answered on-screen or in-person thousands of times, but your choices have always been limited. Imagine the flexibility to pay however you want - credit, debit, multiple currencies, frequent flyer miles, loyalty points, or digital payments - all on the same card or digital wallet. Sound impossible? Episode Six makes the seemingly impossible happen every day. 

We’re a global provider of API-based payment processing and wallet management infrastructure. We’re 100% cloud-native, hyper-configurable, and a “Top 10 Place to Work in Fintech.” And we’re changing how people think about payments. 

Today, we’re powering payments for one of the world’s largest banks and airlines and numerous innovative fintechs. E6 is headquartered in Austin with offices in Tokyo, Singapore, Brisbane, and London. We provide technology for clients in 24 countries on four continents. Since 2018 when we launched with HSBC, we have grown more than 10x. 

Interested in redefining what’s possible in payments? Join Episode Six today.  

What we’re hiring for:  

We are a growing fintech organization looking to add a Security Operations Centre (SOC) Graduate Trainee for our Security Team. 

Role Overview: 

The Security Operations Centre (SOC) Graduate Trainee role is a hands-on information security position, working in a security sensitive, hybrid cloud environment. It requires configuring and using security tools, performing day-to-day security operations, maintaining documentation, and working with internal and external parties. 

Strong candidates bring an understanding of common technical security controls and how they are applied to ensure the ongoing security of critical assets in a 24/7 environment. 

What you’ll be responsible for in this role: 

• Monitor, investigate, triage, and respond to security alerts and incidents generated by security monitoring platforms.  

• Administer and maintain security technologies, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and vulnerability scanning solutions. 

• Conduct routine security log reviews across production, disaster recovery, development, cloud, and corporate environments.  

• Perform security event analysis to identify suspicious activity, indicators of compromise, and emerging threats.  

• Support vulnerability management activities, including vulnerability assessment, risk analysis, remediation tracking, and reporting.  

• Perform security compliance reviews of critical infrastructure, including user access management, privileged account management, patching, firewall configurations, endpoint security controls, and system hardening standards.  

• Support incident response and investigation activities, including evidence collection, documentation, escalation, and lessons learned reviews.  

• Deliver security awareness and operational security training to employees where appropriate.  

• Participate in an on-call, shift, and weekend support rota to ensure continuous security monitoring and response capabilities. 

What experiences and skills are necessary to be successful in this role:  

Mandatory 

• 0-2 years of experience with a primary focus in Information Security 

• Formal security certification, or working towards certification 

• Good understanding of security controls  

• Knowledge of security capabilities available in Linux, Windows, and AWS Cloud Computing environments 

• Good understanding of network security tools such as firewalls and NIDS 

Desirable 

• Security experience working in Hybrid Cloud environments 

• Previous security work with PCI DSS compliant environment

records.title: Associate SDE
records.officialDescription: About Hevo: Hevo is a Series B data infrastructure company with $42M raised. More than 2,000 companies across 40 plus countries use Hevo to move data from more than 150 sources into platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery. Our customers include DoorDash, Shopify, Pinterest, Postman and Icelandair. Our engineering team is built in India, and so are the decisions. We are not the remote engineering office of a US company. The people building the product are the people deciding what to build. What we are building: We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself. No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed. Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part. The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months? That is the job. What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo: Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction. Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing. Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship. Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks. Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality. Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions What you’ll bring to the table: Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles. Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics. Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) - no deep expertise needed. Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges. Candidate Persona: Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools. B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college. Why this role: Very few teams are building autonomous AI systems that operate production infrastructure where being wrong has real consequences. This is not a chatbot. It is infrastructure that has to remain correct, quietly, for months. If that kind of problem excites you, there are not many places working on it this early. You can talk to anyone in the company, including the CEO. What you are trusted with depends on what you can do, not your title.

records.title: Security Engineer Intern
records.officialDescription:
About Fam (previously FamPay) Fam is India's first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors. About the Role We are looking for a Security Enthusiast who thinks like a hacker but works for the good guys. You shouldn't just find bugs; you should be obsessed with understanding why they exist and how to fix them for good. As an Application Security Engineer Intern, you will be the first line of defense for the Fam. You will break things before the bad guys do, automate security checks, and work side-by-side with our engineering team to build a fortress around our users' hard-earned money. If you get a rush from finding an RCE, live on r/netsec, or spend your weekends capturing flags or bounties, this role is for you. Note: This is an onsite internship at Fam HQ, Bangalore. Curious to know about FamPay's tech stack? Click here to know what makes and keeps Fam running!

On the Job 
• Break the App: Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) on our Web Applications, Android/iOS Apps, and APIs.

• Automate Defense: Help integrate security tools (SAST/DAST) into our CI/CD pipelines. We believe security should move as fast as our code.

• Code Review: Review source code for security flaws (like SQLi, XSS, IDOR) and help developers write secure code from day one.

• Bug Triage: Analyze incoming bug reports from our Bug Bounty programs, validate them, and prioritize fixes.

• Threat Modeling: Work with product and engineering teams during the design phase to identify potential security risks before a single line of code is written.

• Learn & Evolve: Stay updated with the latest CVEs, zero-days, and security trends.
Who you are
• The Hacker Mindset: You have a deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 (Web & Mobile) and know how to exploit and patch them.

• Tool Wizardry: Hands-on experience with tools like Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Postman, or similar open-source security tools.

• Coding Chops: You can read code (Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and write scripts to automate attacks or defenses.

• Curiosity: You are a student of the game. You actively participate in CTFs, Bug Bounties, or have a rank on platforms like HackTheBox/TryHackMe.

• Communication: You can explain a complex vulnerability to a developer without sounding like a robot.
Bonus Points
• Experience with Cloud Security (AWS/GCP).

• A Hall of Fame mention in any major tech company's Bug Bounty program.

• Open source security contributions.
Why Join Us?
• Impact: You’ll be protecting the financial data of millions of teenagers. The bugs you find and fix will have a direct, real-world impact.

• Mentorship: Work directly with founding members and senior engineers who have built systems at scale.

• Perks: Competitive stipend, Certificate and Letter of Recommendation, Friendly leave policy, and cool Fam merchandise!

Ready to be part of the Fam? Apply Now and complete this challenge - https://ctf.fampay.co/

records.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
records.officialDescription:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers. We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about. Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number. We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!

About Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the whole job for a customer: understand the problem, design the solution, build it with Claude Code and other AI coding tools, roll it out, and keep it running.
This is a hands-on role that sits close to the customer. You will talk to them, understand how their business works, and turn that into software they use every day. You own what you build, from the first line of code to live in production.

You will not be one small cog in a large system. You will ship whole things.

This role is for you if - 

• You have worked as a solutions engineer, implementation engineer, or in a similar delivery role, and you now want to build the product, not just configure it

• You like being in front of customers and owning delivery end-to-end

• You want to ship with the newest AI coding tools and grow fast
What you will do
• Run discovery with customers to understand how their business works and what they need

• Design the solution, then build it using Claude Code or similar AI harnesses

• Take a customer problem and turn it into a working product, end to end

• Roll out and onboard the product with the customer, and train their team to use it

• Deploy and maintain what you build on our stack

• Fix bugs, add features, and keep customer products running and reliable

• Work with customers and internal teams to scope what to build next

• Answer customer queries about how their product works and how their data is handled
What we are looking for
• 1 to 2 years of experience building or delivering software for customers. This can be as a software engineer, solutions engineer, implementation engineer, or similar.

• You have built and deployed at least one full web app, at work or as a personal project

• You are comfortable with modern application frameworks

• You already use AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar, and you are good at it

• You can work with a database and deploy to the cloud

• You are good with customers. You can run a call, ask the right questions, and explain things simply.

• You are based in Bengaluru and can work onsite

• You are comfortable with working hours that overlap with US customers
Why you'll love us
• You'll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact

• You'll get to work with really smart and helpful people

• We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations

• Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture

• Flexible PTO policy

• Unlimited ai usage

• Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

records.title: AI Generalist Intern
records.officialDescription:
About HexCoded HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine. We're a very small team, based in Gurugram and working remotely, building the tools that are reshaping how video, image and audio get made. You'd work directly with me. Small team means nothing sits between you and the thing that ships.

What you'll actually work on
• Live in the product. Your first week is spent making real videos in Creative Studio, across our video and image models, until you know where it breaks. Then you tell us - specifically, with the fix, not just the complaint.

• Own a fix end to end. Find the thing that loses us users, argue for it, spec it tightly enough to build, and build the parts you can. You will ship to production in your first month.

• Know the models cold. Sixteen video and image models sit in one place. Learn what each is good at, what it costs and where it falls over - and be the person who can say which one to reach for, and why.

• Talk to users. On calls, on chat, in their own words. Bring back what they actually said, not a summary of what we hoped they said.

• Know the market better than its own marketing pages. What every competing tool costs, what it does better than us, and where we win.

• Whatever is on fire. Some weeks that is a vendor, a spreadsheet, a hiring pipeline or a launch. This is the honest part of the job.
What you'll bring
• You have built something real with AI. Not a tutorial - a thing that exists, that someone other than you has used. Whether you hand-wrote the code or drove a model to write it matters far less than whether it works and whether you can walk us through how.

• You check the machine's work. You can point at a time AI confidently handed you something wrong, and say how you caught it. "It didn't get anything wrong" is the wrong answer.

• You read a product like an owner. You notice the thing that costs a user money or time, and you can say what you would do about it - precisely enough that someone could go build it.

• High agency. You close loops without being chased. Given a half-formed problem and no instructions, you come back with it handled - or with the one question that was actually blocking you.

• Clear, short writing. Most of your output is words other people act on. Long and vague is worse than short and wrong.

• Speed over polish. You would rather ship ten rough things this week than one perfect thing next month.

• Six months, full time, remote. Final-year student or a 2026 graduate. Any degree.

How to apply

• Open Creative Studio and make something first. Sign up, generate one video, and find where it frustrates you. Then apply and tell us the single thing you'd fix - and how you'd build it.

• That paragraph is what we read first. A CV is fine, but it is not what decides this. Applications that clearly have not opened the product do not get past the first pass.

records.officialDescription:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact. Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable: end to end. That trust depends on the data underneath being clean, connected, and reliable. Your focus will be on data integrations and quality, connecting new data sources into our system, checking the data we ingest for gaps and anomalies, and supporting the QA and automation work that keeps our predictions accurate. This is a hands-on learning role: you won't just be handed a checklist. When something in the data looks off, we'll want you to dig into why, not just flag it. • Prior internship experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role, preferably in a product-based, lean startup particularly in logistics, ecommerce or B2B SaaS data-heavy domain.  

• 
Willing to learn over "already knows everything": we hire interns for curiosity and effort. You put in the work to understand our domain, product, data, and customers.

• 
Curious by Default: when the data surprises you, you chase the why. You ask good questions early and treat every gap as something worth understanding.

• 
You own your output, AI included. You can use AI tools to move faster, but you read and validate what they produce, you don't just paste it. If one day the tool isn't there, you can still write the query yourself. You can explain what you did and why, without saying "the AI did it."

An eye for detail: you notice when a number looks wrong before anyone else does.
